explanation: Controlled reruns from the same saved graph were exact at 5,360 bp with zero polishing rounds, including a zero-round resume control. One polishing round gave 5,356 bp; two rounds gave 5,355 bp and reproduced the entire historical output file exactly. This confirms polishing introduced the sequence loss in this case. End cropping is strongly implicated, but the specific internal trimming branch has not been instrumented. The older 97.01% mapped fraction also omitted a present 155 bp origin-crossing segment.
scope: This archived contig only; does not establish the assembler-internal cause, topology or a general tool outcome.
summary: Polishing introduced deletions; historical output reproduced

validation.scope: Direct sequence equality for this archived contig; not a general alignment algorithm.
